CAL_B2K_TYPE='BRANCH' AND  CAL_B2K_ID='1587' AND MMYYYY='021984' (UPDATED) .
CAL_B2K_TYPE='BRANCH' AND  CAL_B2K_ID='1058' AND MMYYYY='082051' (DELETED) . 
CAL_B2K_TYPE='BRANCH' AND  CAL_B2K_ID='1302' AND MMYYYY='011996' (UNCHANGED) .
CAL_B2K_TYPE='9999' AND  CAL_B2K_ID='999' AND MMYYYY='999999' (NEW RECORD) . 

select CAL_B2K_TYPE CAL_B2K_TYPE2,SCD_START_DATE SCD_START_DATE_2, SCD_END_DATE SCD_END_DATE_2,* from (
SELECT CAL_B2K_TYPE CAL_B2K_TYPE2, * FROM
EDS.DEP_HOLIDAYMASTTABLE WHERE CAL_B2K_TYPE='BRANCH' AND  CAL_B2K_ID='1587' AND MMYYYY='021984'
UNION ALL
SELECT CAL_B2K_TYPE CAL_B2K_TYPE2, * FROM
EDS.DEP_HOLIDAYMASTTABLE WHERE CAL_B2K_TYPE='BRANCH' AND  CAL_B2K_ID='1058' AND MMYYYY='082051'
UNION ALL
SELECT CAL_B2K_TYPE CAL_B2K_TYPE2, * FROM
EDS.DEP_HOLIDAYMASTTABLE WHERE CAL_B2K_TYPE='BRANCH' AND  CAL_B2K_ID='1302' AND MMYYYY='011996'
UNION ALL
SELECT CAL_B2K_TYPE CAL_B2K_TYPE2, * FROM
EDS.DEP_HOLIDAYMASTTABLE WHERE CAL_B2K_TYPE='9999' AND  CAL_B2K_ID='999' AND MMYYYY='999999') temp order by CAL_B2K_TYPE, SCD_START_DATE
